channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: U.S. Rep. Sylvia Garcia appears on course to win Democratic primary in TX-29, despite redistricting
item.description: Republicans in the Texas Legislature shifted the boundaries of Texas’ 29th Congressional District, dramatically transforming its demographics and encouraging two primary challengers. A new poll shows her with a solid lead over both her rivals for the Democratic nomination.

item.title: James Talarico interview on ‘The Late Show’ pulled from broadcast by CBS execs, Colbert says
item.description: Talarico, a Democratic candidate for one of Texas' U.S. Senate seats, was set to appear on "The Late Show" on Monday. Host Stephen Colbert lambasted the decision not to air the interview, which was shared on YouTube.

item.title: Primary voting begins (Feb. 17, 2026)
item.description: On Tuesday's show: Early voting begins today for the 2026 Texas primaries. We get a preview of the races on the ballot. And we discuss the challenges restaurants are facing these days.

item.title: Early voting in Houston area starts Tuesday for March 2026 primary elections
item.description: Voters registered in Harris County can cast their primary ballot at any polling location across the county. And they can vote in either the Republican or Democratic primary.

item.title: Harris County residents can view their potential new flood risk under proposed FEMA map
item.description: The proposed map -- which was quietly released on the agency's site two weeks ago and intended for technical reviews by floodplain administrators -- marks a major revision in Harris County's flood risk zones that haven't seen a comprehensive update in nearly 20 years.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 17, 2026)
item.description: Today: Former FBI profiler Mary Ellen O'Toole discusses the Nancy Guthrie abduction case, former U.S. District Judge Vanessa Gilmore tells us about her career, and we learn about the musical traditions of Mardi Gras.

item.title: University of Houston-Downtown now offers guaranteed admission to all HISD graduates with a 2.5 GPA or higher
item.description: The University of Houston-Downtown is partnering with Houston ISD offering guaranteed admissions to qualified graduates. The move would grant nearly 8,000 current seniors automatic admission to the University.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 17, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Texas Democrats launch $30 million coordinated campaign to target key races, flip state in 2026
item.description: The effort is a partnership between the state party, two of its largest political organizations and the House Democrats’ campaign arm.

item.title: Texas Parks and Wildlife Department closes oyster harvest area in Galveston Bay
item.description: The decision for the closure was made after the department determined there weren’t enough legal-sized oysters, or oysters that are three inches or greater, in the area.
